author: 阿星
content:
**发布时间：2025-07-25**

你有没有因为 agency 太痛苦，而决定建个工具解决问题？

Mas Hossain就是这样。

他从10岁开始 coding，给Twitch streamers和初创公司建网站。

后来开了 agency。

现在，他在建Queue——帮助 agency owners 在一个地方运营一切的平台。

从billing clients on subscription到managing projects到sending work out for review and feedback。

全部都在那里。

他们7位数ARR，每月都在增长。

## 为自己而建

真正激励他开始的是回想他运营自己 agency 时——

just him，stay up late，trying to make clients happy and get paid。

每次有人在Queue上launch new agency，都把他带回那个 grind。

That's what drives him。

He's building for those ambitious founders chasing something of their own。

He sees himself in their journeys，and that keeps him inspired。

## 产品 building 过程

他为建了自己第一个版本。

他知道从客户那里获得清晰反馈有多难。

Most clients are not great at it unless you guide them。

他用Ruby on Rails做API，React做前端。

从一开始，他就 heavily focus 于设计。

If the product is not super intuitive，it creates friction，and you lose them fast。

所以他确保他自己 actually enjoy using it。

从那里，他和空间里的朋友分享、获得 honest feedback、不断改进。

People like to make this part complicated，but it is really simple：

Build something，get tough feedback，improve it，and repeat。

## 营销太少是 mistake

最大的挑战一直是让人们找到他们。

They did almost no marketing or sales early on，and that was a big mistake。

To be honest，they still do very little. It's tough when you're a small team。

One thing that has really helped is joining communities。

He just shows up and answers questions。

His username is always "Mas from usequeue dot com"，

so people know where he is from。

He does not need to say anything like "Hey，try out Queue."

He just tries to be helpful，and people notice。

They see his name，get curious，and end up checking out the site on their own。

That alone brought in a lot of interest。

And they do things like this interview，posting on Indie Hackers，

or sharing what they're building——just to get the word out。

They also ran outbound email campaigns that were super personalized。

He would record a Loom video walking through their website

and then showed how their software could help——
one by one for each prospect。

And timing is important too。

Lately，with the rise of vibe coding，more people are starting their own agencies，

and that has brought in a lot of new interest。

If he had to start over，he would focus on marketing much earlier。

And he would try to partner with people in the space who already have audiences。

## 最后的建议

Make sure you have a way to get your product in front of people。

Join a community，start an email list，or create your own group。

The worst thing you can do is build something，but have no one to try it。

That feeling of having zero customers，zero feedback，and thinking you wasted your time is brutal。

Do it yourself。

If he could do it again，he would be more resourceful in the beginning；

he would not hire right away。

He would do the work himself，build a clear process，

and only hire once he knew exactly what needed to be done。

Do not stress about funding。

Just focus on building something great and the investors will come later。

And most importantly，build something for yourself。

If no one else ends up using it，at least you will。

And chances are，you are not the only one with that need。

If it solves a real problem for you，there are others out there who will want it too。

You just have to find them。

## 下一步

他们的目标是继续 profitable 运营，开始添加很多AI产品。

They want to become an AI-first platform that helps agencies grow and succeed。

*原文来源：Indie Hackers - Mas Hossain访谈*
